::: {.mf-notice}
Synthetic data

Every study, author, DOI and value in this hub is **invented**. The data reproduce the *structure* of a real resistance-training extraction corpus so that the workflow can be demonstrated end to end. Nothing here is evidence about training.
:::

This site is built from the hub repository's own data. The hub is a corpus of data extracted from training studies, stored as plain CSV tables in Git. It is the single source that separate analysis projects (*spokes*) read from, each pinned to a fixed commit or tag. This hub also answers its own primary questions: the analyses and plots here are produced by the repository's `targets` pipeline from the data at the commit the site was built from.
